# Introduction

This week is focused on applying the tools and concepts learned so far to a small individual data science project.

# Learning goals

1. Develop and refine the mini individual project

2. Apply data science tools to an agricultural problem

3. Practice organizing code, data, and project workflows

4. Get feedback and troubleshoot project challenges

# Lecture - ML and AI Basics

Introduction to machine learning and artificial intelligence, with examples from agriculture (Supervised vs. unsupervised learning in agricultural contexts) (Part 2)

# Lab - Work on Mini Individual Project

Dedicated hands-on time for project development, troubleshooting, and instructor support.

# Discussion - Q&A & Introduction to Tableau

Continued project discussion and introduction to Tableau for agricultural data visualization.

# Assignment

Submit a progress update on your mini individual project.

# Looking ahead

The mini project will prepare you for the **larger team-based final project**. We will soon introduce the expectations for working with real farm data and collaborating with farmers.
